description_short: Create forestry designations for Forestry Towers and inspect planting coverage.
description_long: Auto Forestry Designations Automatically creates forestry designations for your Forestry Towers — no manual painting required. Planned features - Create Designations: Scan the tower area and place valid forestry designations. - Clear Designations: Remove forestry designations managed by the selected tower. - Information Panel: Show planting coverage, existing designations, trees, and stumps. Compatible with vanilla saves — can be added to or removed from existing saves safely.
